name: Bloom
description: Bloom brings natural-language, meaning-aware search to Jellyfin. Ask for "80s horror but funny" or "movies like Heat" and get ranked results, backed by a Bloom search server with keyword + semantic fusion and reranking. Degrades cleanly to fast keyword search (Meilisearch) when the server is absent. Soft fork of the Meilisearch plugin by a.sac.
overview: Semantic, natural-language search for your Jellyfin library
